description:
"Unique, charming one-bedroom maisonette"

This ground-floor maisonette is situated on St Georges Terrace, Jesmond. Benefits from having a full refurbishment recently, making it an ideal property for first-time buyers and investors alike.

The Tour

From the main communal door, you enter the communal entrance leading to a private front door, a private hallway leading to a double bedroom and a bathroom to the ground floor. Stairs leading to the first floor with an open plan lounge kitchen benefiting from three double glazed windows on two aspects.

External Space

The property includes a well-presented communal garden to the front and communal off-street parking to the rear.

Local Area

Ideally located on the desirable St. Georges Terrace, which is centrally located within Jesmond and ideally placed close to the shops, cafes, and amenities of Acorn Road and also the nightlife of Osborne Road.
